verdict.rationale: The only event-triggered automation in the evidence is a preset toggle to sync invoices to Xero automatically the day after payroll processing; holiday designation also happens automatically. The Xero account-mapping overrides are static configuration rules that trigger nothing. There is no general facility for users to define their own event-to-action rules, so this barely counts. Missing for 10: user-defined rule or workflow builder, a choice of trigger events and actions, conditional logic, webhooks or API-based automation, and independent corroboration.
